content: The next section is dedicated to related work on question answering, question similarity and entailment. In Section SECREF3 , we present two machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) methods for RQE and compare their performance using open-domain and clinical datasets. Section SECREF4 describes the new collection of medical question-answer pairs. In Section SECREF5 , we describe our RQE-based approach for QA. Section SECREF6 presents our evaluation of the retrieved answers and the results obtained on TREC 2017 LiveQA medical questions.
